faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for CEC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 10 November 2026, and candidates report at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for CEC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 10 November 2026 at 10:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for CEC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: First class 3-year Diploma in Electronics / First class B.Sc degree in Electronics.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Test / Interview. Preparation of rank list. Test / Interview on 10-11-2026 at 10.00 AM.

faq.question: Q5. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Temporary appointment against the vacancy in the 2026-27 academic year. A rank list will be prepared from the test / interview.

faq.question: Q6. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: College of Engineering Chengannur, Alappuzha, Kerala.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Original certificates proving qualification; Attested copies of these certificates.
